Kifunensine is used as a pharmacological inhibitor of mannosidase I to modulate glycan length, mapping to small-molecule inhibitor treatment. The primary proteomics analysis (LC-MS/MS) is used to validate glycan occupancy and composition across these different genetic and chemical perturbations.
